The Cactus Randomizer - IRL Chrome Dino Part 4
•••
Check out SOLIDWORKS for Makers in my profile and use code ENGINEEZY for 20% off
•••
By adding two more cactus magazines and connecting them onto a belt driven slider, I’m now able to change the magazine that is taking the object off of the conveyor belt. Selecting these magazines at random allows me to fully randomize the objects.  Then I was able to add a gate system that can choose whether to drop a single object or a double object onto the belt.  These two things combined to create an unpredictable game.
